text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - routing anomaly observed: sudden spike of hosted requests being accepted by Dedicated pools in us-west-2. Auto-fallback rate increased x12 in last 2m. Alerting on 'policy.mismatch' and 'tenant_isolation_violation'.
Annie C: Paging SRE oncall, this looks like cross-tenant routing — taking initial triage.
SRE Oncall: On it. Can someone drop recent policy commits? I'll grab logs.
Raj P: I see a config push at 2025-11-18T14:27:03Z that touched smart-routing maps. Possibly bad merge from feature branch. cc @Dave M
Dave M: yep that was me running a mass-update to promote a new fallback weight algorithm. I tested locally but maybe the promotion script had a flag inverted.
Lina S: Any customer-facing impact yet? Support flagged 3 customers complaining about elevated latencies and unexpected model variants.
Annie C: Running quick impact query: `select count(*) from requests where routed_to='dedicated' and origin='hosted' and ts > now() - interval '10 minutes';` Getting ~3.2k requests across 7 tenants.
SRE Oncall: Reproduced. Also seeing KV cache misses spike and token cost jump.
incident-bot: Related alarm: `tenant_isolation_violation` threshold breached for tenant_ids [t-8742, t-4431, t-0092].
Raj P: Config diff (excerpt):
```
- route_priority: [hosted, dedicated]
+ route_priority: [dedicated, hosted]
 fallback_policy:
   allow_model_variant_swap: true
```
Looks like the list order got reversed during the promotion job. That explains dedicated-first behavior.
Dave M: omg. That's on me. Rolling back now.
Annie C: Before rollback, we need live mitigation: flip a runtime flag to force hosted-first for affected tiers, and scale down dedicated acceptance for these tenant IDs to prevent further bleed. Can someone run the emergency toggle?
Raj P: Running emergency toggle `PATCH /v1/runtime/flags/smart_routing_priority` with body `{ "override": "hosted_first", "scope": "tier:capacity:all" }`
Raj P: Response 200.
incident-bot: Action logged: runtime-override by Raj P @ 1739990028.
SRE Oncall: Confirming metrics — fallback rate dropped 70% in 30s. Latency for affected tenants coming down.
Lina S: Notifying the three affected customers via support with a short blurb and ETA. Draft: "We observed temporary routing configuration issue which routed some traffic to dedicated pools causing higher latency. Mitigation in progress; we will follow up with timeline and RCA."
Sales Ryan: Flagging account owners for t-8742 and t-4431. We need to proactively offer billing credit if they saw cost spike.
Dave M: I'll open an immediate PR to revert the promotion job change and add a safer invert-check and unit test.
Annie C: Logging timeline so we can page infra: 14:27 config push -> 14:28 first alarms -> 14:29 emergency toggle -> 14:30 fallback drop observed.
SRE Oncall: We should continue to watch for residual cross-tenant state. Running `audit:route_table_dump --since 14:20` now to ensure no stale entries.
Raj P: Audit shows 4 ephemeral route entries with owner tag 'promotion-job' that persisted ~60s longer than expected. Cleaning them up.
Dave M: PR opened #4521 with revert + tests and an extra check to prevent list-order inversion.
Annie C: Post-mitigation steps: 1) Confirm rollback merged and deployed to prod 2) Reconcile tokens/cost for impacted tenants 3) Prepare customer follow-up and coordinated postmortem 4) Add alerting rule for unexpected priority inversion.
Lina S: I'll own customer comms and collect affected request IDs for each tenant.
SRE Oncall: I'll keep monitoring for 30m and then handoff to oncall rotation. If any re-occurrence, escalate to paging.
Raj P: Follow-up: adding a safety assertion in promotion job that checks `route_priority` symmetry before commit. Also scheduling a canary rollout for next promotion.
Annie C: Adding postmortem owners: Dave M (root cause & fix), Raj P (deployment tooling & tests), SRE Oncall (mitigation timeline and monitoring), Lina S (customer impact notes).
incident-bot: Incident state changed to "mitigated" @ 1739990062. Please file incident report and assign severity.
Annie C: Filing Sev2 (because production customer impact + cost exposure) — assigning to postmortem board. Thanks all for fast responses. :thumbsup:
Sales Ryan: I'll draft outreach for affected enterprise accounts and coordinate any credit approvals.
SRE Oncall: Leaving a watch on the channel for the next 30m, then handoff to next oncall.
Annie C: Handoff complete at 1739990066. Closing live thread; will follow up in postmortem channel.
